title: Findings post answer
description: The body of the 200 answer to POST /v1/runs/<id>/findings, findings-post.schema.json: created, the id that Qory Apiary minted for each raise of the batch, by its ref, and open_blocking, the number of open blocking findings that each stage owns after the batch. qory sends passed for a stage when its open_blocking count is 0 or the stage is not listed. The schema cannot check that no two entries of created have the same ref, or that no two entries of open_blocking have the same stage: FindingsPostAnswer.Check in Go does. A reader ignores a member that this schema does not define, unless must_understand lists it.

created.description: One entry for each raise of the batch, at most 100.

id.description: The id of the new finding.

open_blocking.description: The open blocking findings of each stage after the batch, at most 100 stages. A stage that is not listed has none.

stage.description: The stage that owns the findings.

count.description: The number of open findings with severity blocking that the stage owns on the work item, from 0.

must_understand.description: The members of the document that the reader must understand, each as a JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) counted from the document, such as /created. List each once, at most 32. A pointer has no line feed, and writes ~ only as ~0 or ~1. Each pointer is to a member that this schema defines. The reader ignores a member that this schema does not define, unless must_understand lists it. It refuses a document whose must_understand lists a pointer that it does not define.
